description: Ask-a-question run against a hybrid (vector + graph) knowledge base, via an already-registered HybridKnowledgeSearchResource.

outputs.description: Reports search hits (passages + triples) and entities_matched as run metadata.

hybrid_resource_key.label: Hybrid Resource Key
hybrid_resource_key.description: Resource key of an already-registered HybridKnowledgeSearchResource (from a HybridKnowledgeSearchServerComponent in the same code location).

query_text.label: Query Text
query_text.description: Static default query. Can be left unset if every run supplies HybridKnowledgeSearchQueryRunConfig.query_text instead.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Search mode: 'hybrid' (vector + graph expansion), 'vector' (vector store only), or 'graph' (graph expansion only, seeded by entity-name matches in the query).

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
